description: This Java source file defines an immutable data object representing a Recurring Deposit product, including many configuration options and template methods for creating variations of the data object.

classes.name: RecurringDepositProductData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing a Recurring Deposit product, extending DepositProductData, with fields for deposit terms, interest, penalties, and configuration options.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a template RecurringDepositProductData object with default values and options for dropdowns.

methods.name: withCharges
methods.description: Returns a new RecurringDepositProductData object with the specified charges.

methods.name: withTemplate
methods.description: Returns a new RecurringDepositProductData object based on an existing one, populating dropdown options.

methods.name: withAccountingDetails
methods.description: Creates a new RecurringDepositProductData object with specified accounting mappings and account associations.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Constructs a RecurringDepositProductData object with minimal info (id and name), used for referencing existing products.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Creates a new RecurringDepositProductData object by copying from a DepositProductData with additional penalty-related info.

methods.name: withInterestChart
methods.description: Returns a new RecurringDepositProductData object with associated interest rate charts.
